timing: Up: Fresh Curse Window; Rev: rest of run
relic_short: Reroll a fresh Curse
relic_text: Fool's Escape: immediately after drawing a fresh Curse, return it to the deck, shuffle, and draw a replacement. You do not see the replacement before committing. Archive this Relic.
curse_text: No Turning Back: for the rest of the run, you may not pause or quit to the menu during an attempt.

timing: Up: before a floor; Rev: rest of run
relic_short: Silence 1 Curse for a whole floor
curse_short: Swap input device: pad for mouse
relic_text: Ace in the Sleeve: name one active Curse and silence it for an entire floor. It returns when the floor ends. Archive this Relic.
curse_text: Crossed Wires: for the rest of the run, swap your input device - play on a gamepad instead of mouse and keyboard, or the reverse.
curse_fallback: If the game has no gamepad support, move the mouse to your weaker hand.

timing: Up: before an attempt; Rev: rest of run
relic_short: Protect one declared attempt from life loss
curse_short: Foreign audio bed in your ears
relic_text: Premonition: before an attempt begins, declare it foreseen. If that attempt fails, it costs no life and this Relic is archived. If the attempt succeeds, keep this Relic ready.
curse_text: Whispers: for the rest of the run, a foreign audio bed plays in your headphones - radio, static, a voice that is not the game's. Route it to your own monitoring only; the recording stays clean.

timing: Up: before a floor; Rev: rest of run
relic_short: +1 life on one chosen floor (max 4)
relic_text: Abundance: before a chosen floor, add 1 life, up to a maximum of 4. Archive this Relic when declared.
curse_text: Barrenness: for the rest of the run, saturation is pinned to zero. The world loses its colour.

timing: Up: persistent; Rev: rest of run
relic_short: Maximum lives becomes 4 for the rest of the run
curse_short: No chair for the rest of the run
relic_text: Decree: when gained, place this Relic beside the life counter. Maximum lives rises from 3 to 4 for the rest of the run, and every later floor starts full. A card that sets a specific starting value still overrides it. Decree is never archived.
curse_text: March: the throne is taken. No chair for the rest of the run - stand, kneel, or sit on the floor. The choice is yours; the chair does not come back.

timing: Up: at 0 lives; Rev: during every attempt
relic_short: Gain a blue life at 0 lives
curse_short: Never fall silent for over 5 seconds
relic_text: Protective Rite: when a floor reaches 0 lives, archive this Relic and gain 1 blue life for one final attempt. A success still counts as a floor victory.
curse_text: Heresy: during an attempt you may never fall silent for more than 5 seconds. Between attempts, silence is allowed. Rest of the run.

timing: Up: between floors; Rev: rest of run
relic_short: Give one Relic 2 uses
relic_text: Bond: attach this card to one unused Relic. The first time that Relic is used, resolve it but keep it ready; after the second use, archive both cards.
curse_text: Separation: for the rest of the run, you may store at most two unused Relics. When you gain a third, immediately archive one of them.

timing: Up: before a named sequence; Rev: every attempt
relic_short: Unlimited retries for one named chase
relic_text: Momentum: before a clearly bounded chase or escape sequence, name it. Until you clear that sequence, failures inside it do not cost lives and you may restart it as often as needed. Archive this Relic when the named sequence is cleared.
curse_text: Broken Chariot: every remaining attempt runs on a stopwatch set before the floor. Exceeding it ends the attempt and costs 1 life.
curse_fallback: If a floor contains unskippable non-interactive stretches, the clock runs only during active play - cutscenes pause it.

timing: Up: after a fail; Rev: rest of run
relic_short: Cancel one life loss
relic_text: Buffer: after a fail would cost 1 life, archive this Relic and cancel that life loss. The attempt still ends normally.
curse_text: Cracked Strength: for the rest of the run, you play one-handed.
curse_fallback: If one-handed play makes the game unfinishable, your dominant hand plays normally and the other hand may operate exactly one key, chosen before the floor.

timing: Up: during a floor; Rev: rest of run
relic_short: Consult one guide for one question
relic_text: Solitude: once, consult a walkthrough, map, or wiki for one specific question, taking as long as you need. Archive this Relic when you have the answer.
curse_text: Exile: for the rest of the run, a vignette closes the frame. You see the centre; the periphery is eaten.

timing: Up: during a floor; Rev: before every attempt
relic_short: Coin: Heads +1 life; Tails restart floor
curse_short: Toss each attempt; Tails means a small window
relic_text: Better Fortune: call the coin out loud before the toss. Heads: gain +1 life for the rest of the run. Tails: restart the current floor from the beginning. Archive this Relic after the toss.
curse_text: Bad Turn: before every remaining attempt, toss the coin on camera. Heads: play normally. Tails: play that attempt in a window roughly a quarter of the screen.

timing: Up: before a floor; Rev: rest of run
relic_short: -1 life this floor; +2 lives on the next
curse_short: Game audio in one channel only
relic_text: The Scales: before a floor, declare The Scales. Start that floor with 1 life fewer than normal. When it resolves, enter the next floor with 2 extra lives. Archive this Relic when declared.
curse_text: Full Penalty: for the rest of the run, game audio reaches you through one channel only. Set the balance on your own monitoring device; the recording stays clean.

timing: Up: before a floor; Rev: rest of run
relic_short: Play one floor upside-down; +2 lives next
relic_text: The Willing Hang: rotate the display 180 degrees and play one whole floor that way. After the floor resolves, gain 2 extra lives on the next floor. Archive this Relic when declared.
curse_text: Binding: for the rest of the run, the display stays rotated 180 degrees.

timing: Up: any moment; Rev: rest of run
relic_short: Remove any Curse permanently, once
relic_text: Transformation: remove any one active Curse permanently, regardless of its weight. This is the only answer to a Curse of weight 4-5. Once per run; archive this Relic.
curse_text: Silence: for the rest of the run, the game is fully muted. Only your own voice remains.
curse_fallback: If a game cannot be finished without its audio cues, drop to 20% volume through speakers, no headphones.

timing: Up: any moment; Rev: rest of run
relic_short: Restore lives to the floor maximum
relic_text: Temper: once, at any moment, restore your lives to the current floor's maximum. Archive this Relic.
curse_text: Excess: for the rest of the run, mouse sensitivity is pushed to an uncomfortable setting in Windows - at the system level, not in the game.

timing: Up: any floor; Rev: every Victory Draw
relic_short: +2 lives now; begin the Boss with 1 life
curse_short: Every Victory Draw also gives a Curse
relic_text: Pact: take 2 extra lives now. The price is fixed: begin the Boss Floor with exactly 1 life, regardless of your normal maximum. Keep this card visible as a debt marker until the Boss begins, then archive it.
curse_text: Temptation: for the rest of the run, every Victory Draw also hands you one reversed card. Winning is never clean again.

timing: Up: between floors; Rev: rest of run
relic_short: Replay one lost floor from the beginning
relic_text: Ruin and Rebuild: once, choose any regular floor you previously lost and replay it from the beginning with 3 lives. Resolve the replay as a normal floor. Archive this Relic when the replay begins.
curse_text: Collapse: for the rest of the run, monitor brightness sits at minimum. Set it on the display, not as a recording filter.
curse_fallback: If the game is unreadable at minimum brightness, use half your normal brightness setting instead.

timing: Up: before a floor; Rev: current floor only, then expires
relic_short: Remove a light Curse and gain +1 life
curse_short: Relics locked until this floor ends
relic_text: Hope: before a floor, remove one light Curse with weight 1-2 and gain +1 life, up to 4. If no light Curse exists, gain only the life.
curse_text: Extinguishing: every Relic is locked until the current floor resolves. If drawn between floors, the lock holds through the next floor. This Curse then expires on its own - the only Curse in the deck that does.

timing: Up: Fresh Curse Window; Rev: rest of run
relic_short: Delay a fresh Curse by one floor
relic_text: Shadow of the Future: after drawing a fresh Curse, delay its activation until the next floor ends. It then becomes active for the rest of the run. If the next floor is the Boss, it wakes after the first final attempt.
curse_text: Eclipse: half the monitor is physically covered - card, tape, or board. You pick the side when you draw it, and it stays for the rest of the run. No eye patch. The recording stays clean.
curse_fallback: If half the screen hides essential HUD, cover 30% instead.

timing: Up: before a floor; Rev: rest of run
relic_short: Silence all Curses for one floor
relic_text: Full Light: before a chosen floor, silence every active Curse for that entire floor. They all return afterward; archive this Relic.
curse_text: Glare: for the rest of the run, brightness and contrast are blown out. Safe for your eyes, fatal to the mood.

timing: Up: Boss Floor only; Rev: every lost floor
relic_short: Gain a blue life at 0 lives on the Boss
relic_text: Rebirth: if the Boss Floor reaches 0 lives, archive this Relic and gain 1 blue life for one final attempt.
curse_text: Condemnation: for the rest of the run, every floor you lose draws 2 Curses instead of 1.

timing: Permanent system element
relic_short: Keep the Build, or archive 2 Relics to remove 1 Curse
relic_text: Closing the Cycle: The World is not part of the draw deck. After Floor 3, reveal it as the gate to the Boss Floor and resolve its final choice before the first Boss attempt. Keep the Build enters with every unspent Relic and every active Curse; Close the Wound archives 2 unspent Relics to remove 1 chosen active Curse.
curse_text: No reversed effect: The World has no separate reversed effect. It remains outside the draw deck as a permanent structural marker.
